meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取本地屏幕记录软件 screenpipe 抓到的你近期操作,找出你反复进行的工作模式,再对照现有技能,把没覆盖的部分写成新技能草稿或组合配方,供你审核使用。
howto.when: 当你要求它分析你最近几小时/几天/一周的工作并提出新技能时触发;前提是本地 screenpipe 服务在 3030 端口运行,连不上会拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作,提出可以做成技能的新流程。
say.note: 它会先读取 screenpipe 记录并生成报告。

say.text: 看看我最近一周重复做的研究,哪些还没被现有技能覆盖?
say.note: 产出匹配结果和缺口清单。

say.text: 根据我最近的重复操作,起草一个组合技能配置。
say.note: 生成 composition recipe 草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads your recent activity captured by the local screenpipe daemon, detects repeated workflow patterns, compares them against existing skills, and drafts new skill files or composition recipes for uncovered patterns, for you to review and promote.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze your recent work (last hours/days/week) and propose new skills. Requires the local screenpipe daemon running on port 3030; it refuses to run if unreachable.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose workflows worth turning into skills.
say_en.note: Reads screenpipe data and writes a report.

say_en.text: Tell me which of my repeated workflows this week lack existing skill coverage.
Draft a composition recipe from my recent repeated operations.
say_en.note: Generates a thin SKILL.md chaining existing skills.
